snippet.title: Horror game with eyes in space that look at you. - Stares Back
snippet.description:
Stares Back is a visual novel game developed by StephenW313 where you follow the story of Vivian, a woman who, after losing her job, goes into a spiral of conflicting thoughts and decides to look at the sky. There, she finds a strange nebula that hides a strange mystery.
